archFront.src: D side (vaz_2101.jpg, 4.703 mm/px, no overlay registration; read on the drawn front hub (647, 278) px): the well band's outer edge 0.339 over the hub (y 206); its edge 0.03 over the hub's height 0.325 ahead (x 578; at the hub's height it runs into the bumper) and 0.357 behind (x 723)

archRear.src: D side (vaz_2101.jpg, read on the drawn rear hub (1162, 278) px): the arch's thick line 0.235-0.249 over the hub (y 228; the thin line at 0.296 is the lip's outer edge); its edge at the hub's height x 1092 ahead and x 1232 behind (the well's band ends 0.33 each side). A stock 2101 side photo (Commons 'Lada 1200L in Kerava, Finland (side view).jpg') shows it about 0.33 high on a car standing tail-high; the drawing kept, as the 2102/2103/2106 drawings draw it low too

backLightFoot.src: D side (vaz_2101.jpg, 4.703 mm/px, ground row 336, bumper tip px 518.8 = the front hub's 647 less 603 mm): the profile's rear outline (the C pillar's outer line, the edge the check measures on the built car) at px 1221.5 (s 3.305) 0.902 high and px 1209.5 (s 3.248) 0.962 high, carried down to 0.842 as the check carries the built edge (ds/dy −0.95); the line meets the deck at (1232, 154) = s 3.354, 0.856. The earlier 3.254 was the glass's seal line (the inner double line, its foot (1206, 158) = s 3.232, 0.837), not the outline

accepted.why: the 124 shell as the owner accepted it (2026-10-28): its back light 0.045 ahead of the drawn outline at 0.842, 0.035 across the edge (tol 0.03; 0.03 / 0.02 at 0.90 / 0.96, a slightly steeper glass, ds/dy −0.75). A side photo (P Commons 'Lada 1200L in Kerava, Finland (side view).jpg', 1920 px, scale 2.54 mm/px from the rear tyre's 0.576 diameter) puts the outline's foot 0.296 behind the rear door's shut line (read there 2.969, the drawing's 2.972): s ≈ 3.265 in the door's plane, up to 0.05 more for the pillar standing inboard of it; the built edge at the deck (3.306 at 0.856) lies between photo and drawing
